items.title: Simply-connected smooth projective varieties with etale cohomology rings admitting no rational form
items.author: Runjie Hu; Siqing Zhang
items.difficulty_reason: The full construction encodes arithmetic endomorphism/cohomological data into the graded etale cohomology algebra of an auxiliary variety and transfers the obstruction to a simply-connected smooth projective variety using geometric blow-up/projective-bundle constructions and intrinsic recovery of distinguished subspaces/lines. It proves absence of a Q-form for the whole Q_l-algebra, hence the author characteristic-zero lifting obstruction. Original fixed primes p and ell!=p, algebraic-closure and lifting definitions retained. Old distinguished-lines lemma is one recovery step, not the complete existence construction. No support/corollary split count.

primary.label: Complete original simply-connected smooth projective no-Q-form existence theorem and lifting consequence
